description.value: Bread Co. is a fifth-generation Dutch-heritage bakery café whose founders began baking in the Netherlands in 1851; the current Bronswyk family owners bring those traditions to three Kelowna locations. The Pandosy Ave café serves freshly baked artisan breads made with organic flours and sea salt, house-made soups, breakfast and lunch dishes, and a rotating menu of specialty coffee and seasonal drinks. Touring cyclists will find a full-service sit-down café with a vegan bread range and online pickup ordering.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: lockers (secure) at 18m; lockers (secure) at 20m.

The website confirms active business operations with a full breakfast/lunch menu, pickup ordering, and explicitly advertises 'Vegan Artisan Breads' as a menu category and notes gluten-intolerance-friendly options. No bike-specific amenities (rack, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
